description: Under internal ccc, if \(p\) forces a ground name to be a map \(\alpha\to\delta\) of ground ordinals, the ground ZFC-model contains a family \((C_\xi)_{\xi<\alpha}\) of internally countable subsets of \(\delta\) covering every coordinate under every generic through \(p\). Its ground union contains the actual range and has ground cardinality at most \(\max(\aleph_0,|\alpha|)\).
